_comment: Inventory of every modification this fork carries inside upstream-owned files. See AGENTS.md. Seeded 2026-08-26 from fork/main c0123f6d. The count is the number to drive down; platform#z5x2 is expected to remove roughly 41 of these entries.

allowlist and URI rejection made unconditional; option assembly is inline in run()
latch must fire after INSTALL and before the listener; ordering is the security property
